data.body: **[P2] Require the expected operation and attempt spans.** Removing every export except `Invocation` and `Workflow` still passes this validator and `terminal()`, including the replay cases. Duplicating an operation export also passes. Consequently, the acceptance suite can report success when durable operation telemetry disappears or is duplicated. Match operation/attempt spans against the fixture or service history, enforce the expected parents and multiplicities for each view, and add negative controls that remove or duplicate non-root spans.
